hero.slogan: The AI-native workspace for all your knowledge

note.label: Notes
note.title: Keep each idea in its natural structure.
note.body: Write in Markdown, from a passing thought to a complete essay. The structure stays clear, ready to edit, search, or refine with mew at any time.

preview.title: How to build a personal knowledge system that keeps running
preview.body: A useful knowledge system begins with consistent capture and review, not elaborate classification.

clip.label: Web clips
clip.title: Bring the useful part of a page into your workspace.
clip.body: Save the page you are reading with its clean text and original source. Important material no longer disappears into browser bookmarks and remains ready to read or search.

preview.title: From capture to connection: three knowledge loops
preview.body: Keep the article, author, and original link together as searchable material for the long term.

feed.label: Subscriptions
feed.title: Let worthwhile updates come to you.
feed.body: Add RSS sources and receive new articles from the sites you follow. Every update enters one reading space, so you do not have to check each site every day.

preview.title: Designing an information inbox that does not overwhelm
preview.body: New articles arrive in one reading space, always keeping source, time, and content together.

library.label: Knowledge bases
library.title: Shape what you collect into a lasting structure.
library.body: Place notes, clips, and subscribed articles into long-running subjects, then clarify them with knowledge bases and folders. Collected information becomes a structure you can keep maintaining.

preview.title: Personal knowledge system
preview.body: Organize material around a lasting subject, so every new item joins an existing line of thought.

summary.label: Article summaries
summary.title: See what matters before you read in full.
summary.body: When a web clip or subscribed article enters the workspace, mewmo generates a concise summary in the background. Grasp the topic and conclusions first, then decide whether to read deeper.

preview.title: From capture to connection: three knowledge loops
preview.body: The article describes capture, processing, and rediscovery as three loops, arguing that review matters more than classification complexity.

insight.label: Note insights
insight.title: Bring older material into the thought in front of you.
insight.body: After a note changes, mewmo checks it against related material and surfaces missing evidence, repeated angles, or shifts in your thinking. Insights form in the background without interrupting your writing.

preview.title: How to build a personal knowledge system that keeps running
preview.body: You mention review repeatedly but have not defined what should trigger it. A weekly review mechanism could complete the loop.

related.label: Related reading
related.title: Saved information returns when it becomes useful.
related.body: While you read, mewmo finds related notes, clips, and articles across your workspace. Past information appears beside the current question without depending on your memory.

preview.title: Designing an information inbox that does not overwhelm
preview.body: Closely connected to three of your notes about information intake, weekly review, and knowledge connections.

demo.name: Demo
demo.documentTitle: How to build a personal knowledge system that keeps running
demo.mewPrompt: What should I improve next, based on my notes?
demo.mewReply: Your capture flow is already clear. Add a weekly review next, so saved information can return to the work you are doing now.

agent.name: mew Agent
agent.title: It does not just answer. It keeps working with what you know.
agent.prompt: Find the missing loop in this knowledge system and help me turn it into a note I can continue writing.

steps.webDetail: Search and read public sources with citations
steps.insightDetail: Compare existing ideas and locate the gap

agent.previewTitle: Create note: Weekly review is the feedback loop
agent.previewBody: Includes review triggers, input scope, and a next-action checklist. Nothing changes until you confirm.
agent.roadmapTitle: It will understand you more over time

memory.title: Remember your context
memory.body: Long-term memory will retain your goals, preferences, and recurring questions.

skills.title: Work in your way
skills.body: Custom Skills and Automation will turn repeated methods into reusable processes.

proactive.title: Act at the right time
proactive.body: Proactive reviews, reminders, and daily or weekly reports will bring changes to you when they matter.

final.title: Let mewmo start understanding you from your next note.

footer.tagline: Built for people who keep reading, saving, and thinking.

frame.title: Keep the useful parts of the internet close.
frame.description: Collect notes, clipped pages, and feeds into one quiet workspace, then let AI resurface the context when you need it.
